summary: Initialize a user-authorized eight-hour continuation goal and three mechanism-distinct routes for universal multiphase O3a without changing the existing open target or promoting any candidate result.

node.title: Second bounded continuation of universal multiphase O3a
node.statement: Continue the prove-or-refute program for CLM-NGE2-MPO3A-ALL by attacking all-solution residual-Jacobian nondegeneracy or a certified multiple-point witness and by running at least one mechanism-independent proof route.
node.quantifier_contract: For every finite real R>1, every integer n>=2, and each sign max or min, all self-consistent bang-bang points with exactly 2n effective switches coincide a.e.
boundary_cases: n=2, both signs, both endpoint material phases, and asymmetric reflection pairs.
R approaches 1 from above and arbitrary large but finite R.
Interior singular residual points, disconnected components, tangencies, inactive zeros, switch collisions, endpoint escape, eigenvalue indexing, and a.e. representatives.
completion_criteria: A content-hashed proof or refutation package with no unresolved obligations passes independent definition, logic, boundary, and adversarial audits.
An approved immutable proposal is deterministically merged and the post-merge trusted closure or verified refutation resolves CLM-NGE2-MPO3A-ALL.
A detailed LaTeX report is compiled and visually verified when a complete proof or refutation is obtained.
non_completion_conditions: Finite scans, floating roots, sampled Jacobians, or uniqueness only on the known symmetric branch do not count.
A conditional theorem whose missing premise is equivalent to universal uniqueness, an unreviewed candidate, or an unmerged proposal does not count.

node.title: All-solution Jacobian and interior-singularity continuation
node.statement: Seek a universal sign-regular or Morse-index proof of residual-Jacobian invertibility at every self-consistent point, or construct and rigorously certify an interior singular point and associated distinct solutions.
node.method_family: Exact shape Hessian, Green-kernel sign regularity, reflection blocks, Morse index, interval singularity certification
node.deliverable_contract: A complete all-solution nondegeneracy proof, a premise-complete certified singular/multiple-root counterexample, or the first exact null-vector obstruction with restart conditions.
falsification_tests: Check n=2 and both signs without symmetry assumptions.
Separate known symmetric-branch nonsingularity from disconnected or asymmetric sheets.
Reject eigenvalue misindexing, collapsed cells, and unverified finite-difference determinants.
node.expected_bottleneck: Controlling the sign or inertia of both reflection sectors at every solution rather than along sampled branches.

node.title: Reflection polarization and strict comparison route
node.statement: Attempt to rule out every asymmetric self-consistent point by a reflected two-cell polarization, strict spectral comparison, or a minimal asymmetric-pair contradiction independent of residual-Jacobian nondegeneracy.
node.method_family: Reflection comparison, two-point polarization, strict spectral variation, and minimal asymmetric cell pairs
node.deliverable_contract: A direct symmetry theorem, an exact polarization obstruction/counterexample, or the first precise comparison inequality that fails.
falsification_tests: Do not use S=0 or assume reflection symmetry.
Test the smallest n=2 asymmetric cell displacement and both saturation signs.
Distinguish stationarity of global extrema from self-consistency alone.
node.expected_bottleneck: Self-consistent points are stationary switch configurations but need not be global extrema under arbitrary polarization paths.

node.title: Projective transfer order and total-positivity route
node.statement: Reformulate the complete alternating interface system as a product of projective transfer maps and seek a global order, total-positivity, or continued-fraction injectivity theorem independent of local Jacobian continuation.
node.method_family: SL(2,R) transfer words, Riccati/Pruefer projective order, total positivity, and continued fractions
node.deliverable_contract: A global injectivity/order theorem for the full interface map, an exact order-reversal witness refuting the route, or one strictly weaker reusable transfer lemma.
falsification_tests: Audit n=2, both signs, projective poles, and cell phases crossing pi/2.
Do not import symmetric-relay uniqueness or residual-Jacobian invertibility.
Check whether any claimed total positivity survives alternating materials and two distinct eigenfrequencies.
node.expected_bottleneck: Möbius derivatives are locally positive but global phase wrapping and alternating cells may destroy a common product order.

rationale.scope: The mathematical target is unchanged; this transaction records a new operational window and three independent research mechanisms.
rationale.independence: The Jacobian route attacks the existing sufficient bridge; polarization uses global reflected comparisons; transfer order seeks global projective injectivity. The latter two do not assume the Jacobian conclusion.
rationale.computation_policy: All finite or floating computation is non-propagating unless a premise-complete interval or exact certificate is produced.
rationale.novelty_policy: No novelty or priority claim is made.

math_research_state_records.status_justification: The unchanged universal target is outside trusted closure and the user authorized a fresh bounded continuation window.
The all-solution nondegeneracy/certified-singularity route is initialized but has produced no new result.
The reflection-polarization route is mechanism-independent and initialized without assuming symmetry or extremality.
The projective transfer-order route is initialized without assuming Jacobian invertibility or symmetric-relay injectivity.
